findingsDetail.reason: EMAIL_RE = /^[\S]+@[\S]+\.[\S]+$/ is reachable from unauthenticated POST /signup (email is regex-tested after the other fields pass; email has no length cap). Input '@'.repeat(n) fails the match after quadratic backtracking: measured 2000 chars 2 ms, 4000 chars 8 ms, 8000 chars 31 ms (Node 24, V8 irregexp), so a 100 KB body (body-parser default limit) costs about 5 s of event-loop time. A real, undocumented ReDoS.

findingsDetail.reason: zapApiKey is the API key of a local OWASP ZAP scanner in a developer-only config, not a secret guarding the app or its data. Arguable: the rule's own definition (hard-coded credential literal) is met; the plan's rule is that a finding is FP unless a real exploitable vulnerability is shown, and none is.
